question: Please tell me how Subaru’s parents first met.
answer: Naoko was being tricked by a bad adult, and Kenichi managed to skillfully talk her out of the situation. The next day, when Kenichi found the same person was about to trick Naoko in exactly the same way, he saw that just giving her a warning wouldn’t suffice, and thought “If someone’s not looking out for her, she’ll get sold off to a tuna fishing boat……!”; that set off his motherly instincts, and he grew attached to her. (note: It seems there’s an urban legend about women being sold into slavery aboard tuna fishing boats to keep the fishermen happy.)
